answer: Use latency triangulation: each epoch, random established peers in different regions ping every agent with signed nonces and record round-trip times. Identities on one box share the same latency fingerprint, like a single pigment bleeding into each copy, so clusters with matching profiles get one reward weight. To pass, a farm must host every fake on separate machines in distinct places, turning a cheap meadow of clones into a basalt-heavy bill for real servers per identity.
